baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic environmental photograph of a spring-wound Clockpunk eclipse rehearsal inside a midnight civic time tower. An unmistakably adult woman, whose broad appearance cues are guided only by the supplied portrait, has long near-black wavy hair, warm brown eyes, softly arched brows, an oval face, and natural rose lips. Wearing a charcoal horologist’s coat threaded with fine watch chains, she turns an oversized brass winding key inside a glass-cased astronomical clock. The key action visibly releases a palm-sized enamel mechanical bird from an opened escapement cage as a coiled mainspring unspools, interlocking brass gears advance concentric numbered dials, and a moon-phase disk clicks into eclipse. Surround her with suspended pocket watches, calibration tools, and a wall-sized gear train, all built as tactile practical machinery. Prioritize readable hand-to-key contact, functional spring-and-escapement causality, richly aged brass, enamel, glass, and a believable photographed human presence.
